abstract: P53 tumor suppressor gene protein immunostaining was evaluated in the primary tumor of adult testicular germ cell cancer to assess if P53 expression would serve as a clinically useful tumor marker. Representative archival tissues from 152 orchiectomy specimens were studied for P53 immunohistochemistry. Seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor constituents revealed P53 expression via immunohistochemistry in 90% and 94% of the cases, respectively. For seminoma, there was a trend toward decreased P53 expression with advancing stage. For nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, although all cellular components showed variable P53 expression, P53 expression in embryonal carcinoma constituents increased among stages of disease. A third of pathological stage I cancer patients exhibited 2+ or greater P53-embryonal staining compared with 61% with stage II (p = 0.0670) and 67% with stage III (p = 0.0815) disease, respectively (Kruskal-Wallis, 2-sided test). As a secondary objective, we wanted to determine if P53 immunohistochemistry would be useful to predict occult disease in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. This group was studied for P53-embryonal immunohistochemistry, the presence of vascular invasion and the quantitative determination of percentage of embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumor in a multivariate fashion to assess if these tests could be clinically useful to predict occult disease. Degree of P53 immunostaining of the embryonal component in the primary tumor was statistically greater for stage II by univariate logistic regression analysis (p = 0.0362). Similarly, the per cent embryonal cancer (p = 0.0002) and vascular invasion (p = 0.0005) were highly significant as predictors of occult stage II disease via the univariate testing. By multivariate logistic regression analysis, the model consisting of per cent embryonal cancer and vascular invasion provided the best prediction of occult disease in the clinical stage I cohort. In addition, this model had the highest sensitivity and specificity of all multivariate models considered. The addition of P53-embryonal staining did not improve predictability nor sensitivity/specificity. The P53 tumor suppressor gene protein is expressed to some degree in most testicular germ cell tumors and degree of staining/expression varies according to stage of disease. From the standpoint of a clinically useful primary tumor risk factor for predicting occult disease, vascular invasion by the tumor and percentage of embryonal carcinoma component in the tumor are more useful than P53 immunohistochemistry.
abstract_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発腫瘍におけるp53腫瘍抑制遺伝子産物の免疫染色を評価し、臨床的に有用な腫瘍マーカーとなり得るかを検討した。精巣摘除術標本152例の保存組織を対象にp53免疫組織化学を行った。セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の構成成分では、それぞれ90%および94%の症例でp53発現が認められた。セミノーマでは、病期の進行に伴いp53発現が低下する傾向があった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、各構成成分は程度の差はあるもののp53発現を示した。胎児性癌成分のp53発現は病期の進行とともに増加した。病期Iの患者の約3分の1は胎児性癌成分でp53-embryonal染色が2+以上であったのに対し、病期IIでは61%、病期IIIでは67%であった(Kruskal-Wallis検定、両側、p=0.0670およびp=0.0815)。副次的な目的として、臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における潜在性病期II疾患の予測に、p53免疫組織化学が有用かどうかを検討した。この群について、原発腫瘍の胎児性癌成分におけるp53-embryonal免疫染色、血管侵襲の有無、原発腫瘍中の胎児性癌の割合を定量評価し、多変量解析で検討した。原発腫瘍の胎児性癌成分のp53免疫染色の程度は、単変量ロジスティック回帰解析で病期IIに対して有意に高かった(p=0.0362)。同様に、胎児性癌の割合(p=0.0002)と血管侵襲(p=0.0005)は、単変量解析で潜在性病期II疾患の有意な予測因子であった。多変量ロジスティック回帰解析では、胎児性癌の割合と血管侵襲からなるモデルが、臨床病期Iにおける潜在性疾患の予測に最も優れていた。このモデルは、検討した多変量モデルの中で最も高い感度と特異度を示した。p53-embryonal染色を加えても予測能、感度、特異度は改善しなかった。p53腫瘍抑制遺伝子産物はほとんどの精巣胚細胞腫瘍である程度発現しており、染色の程度や発現は病期によって異なる。病期予測のための臨床的に有用な原発腫瘍のリスク因子としては、腫瘍による血管侵襲と腫瘍中の胎児性癌成分の割合が、p53免疫組織化学よりも有用である。
